ios.desc:
Master the Block Blast puzzle game effortlessly with this ultimate game solver. Whether you’re stuck on a challenging level or aiming for a high score, this app provides the best solutions and strategies to enhance your gaming experience.

- Instant Solutions: Upload a screenshot of your Block Blast puzzle (without pop-ups or overlays), and let our AI-powered solver analyze the grid and figures to deliver step-by-step solutions instantly.
- Manual Input Mode: Recreate any game state by manually filling in blocks, and get optimized solutions tailored to your gaming setup.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us through the app’s feedback feature!

quotes.text:
Hi everyone!  I’ve developed Block Blast Solver app, the ultimate game assistant for mastering Block Blast. Whether you’re stuck on a tough level or aiming for higher scores, this app has you covered:
- Upload a puzzle screenshot or manually input, and the AI-powered solver will provide step-by-step solutions.

It is developed based on image recognition + model algorithm + multi-path analysis, with response rate: <100ms and recognition rate: >99.9%.

I’d love for you to try it out and share your thoughts.

AppStore: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6739669974
Website: https://blockblastsolver.top
